status.summary: Active, coming off a win, with no fight booked. He stopped Manuel Torres 15 seconds into round 2 in the UFC Fight Night 280 main event in Baku, Azerbaijan (Jun 27, 2026). A spinning wheel kick dropped Torres and punches finished it (Wikipedia; Yahoo/Uncrowned; UFC Stats logs the finish as ground punches), and it earned a $100,000 Performance of the Night bonus. He said afterwards that a first-round jab had left him seeing quadruple out of his left eye. Five months earlier Mauricio Ruffy stopped him in round 2 at UFC 325 in Sydney (Jan 31, 2026 US time / Feb 1 local). Pro record 14-5-0 (ESPN, UFCalendar, ufcrankings.org); UFC 8-5; 2-3 in his last five. ESPN and UFCalendar list no upcoming bout on Nov 6, and no new injury has been reported since Baku. He trains at Tiger Muay Thai in Phuket, Thailand, and fights for Azerbaijan.

style.summary: A switch-stance Muay Thai striker built around body kicks: about two of every five significant strikes he lands go to the body, roughly double the lightweight norm. He adds head and wheel kicks, clinch knees and real punching power, and opponents rarely take him down. But he gets drawn into exchanges and takes a lot to the head, which cost him both Gaethje fights and the Ruffy fight.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1. The engine's target split should come from fighters.json: recency-weighted landed shares are head 0.41 / body 0.42 / leg 0.18 and attempt shares are head 0.57 / body 0.31 / leg 0.13 (career landed 0.43 / 0.39 / 0.18; lightweight median landed about 0.62 / 0.22 / 0.15). The body share is about double the division's, which is the main thing the director should show. Body kicks dominate the body group, because his body volume comes at distance (52 body strikes against Gaethje in 2023, 43 in 2025, while 84-87% of his landed strikes are at distance). UFC Stats does not separate body kicks from body punches, so the 0.7 is a judgment. Head kicks (0.12) and spinning (0.15) sit above most lightweights for the Riddell wheel-kick KO. Knee is 0.3 because 10% of his landed strikes come in the clinch. Leg kicks are a generic split with inside slightly ahead, which is a judgment, not data. No published technique breakdown could be fetched in this pass.

engine_notes.note: Body targeting is the defining tendency: 39% of landed significant strikes career and 42% recency-weighted go to the body (median about 22%); 29-31% of his attempts go to the body (median about 14%).
Hard to take down: 90% takedown defence career (47 of 52 stopped), opponent control only 78 seconds per 15 min. He has never attempted a submission and has never been submitted.
ko_losses = 3 counts the 2023 leg-injury stoppage against Gamrot. Only two of his three KO/TKO losses came from strikes (Magomed Mustafaev 2019, Ruffy 2026).
Five-round pace (1.00 / 1.32 / 1.13 / 0.80 relative to round 1) rests mostly on the 2022 Dos Anjos fight, the only one to pass round 2. The round-5 value comes from 18 seconds and should be ignored.
Opponents land mostly to his head (64-68% of what they land), and his losses to Gaethje and Ruffy came from head damage while he won the body exchanges.
